question: How many nations had participated in the Asian Games 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**45**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the 2018 Asian Games**, a total of **45 nations** participated.
 
• **The Asian Games, **also known as Asiad, is a multi-sport event held every four years and is recognized by the **Olympic Council of Asia (OCA).**
 
• The 2018 edition of the Asian Games took place in Jakarta and Palembang, Indonesia, from August **18 to September 2, 2018.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Asian Games 2022, originally scheduled for September this year, will now be held from **September 23 to October 8, 2023.**
 
• The Asian Games were postponed in** May due to the rapid spread of COVID-19 **in and around the host city of Hangzhou in China.
 
• The quadrennial event was scheduled to be held from **September 10 to 25, 2022.**
